To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the experiences, priorities, and values of patients should be continually collected, and fed into data system to monitor ongoing quality improvements and performance benchmarking, in order to create a person-centred learning health system.

A person centred learning healthcare system is one that continuously improves value for patients and their families through the ongoing collection of patient experience and caregiver priorities and values, within the context of the social determinants that shape health and well being."

the patient and caregiver perspective is essential for the development of a person centred approach to value based healthcare in learning health systems, and that the information collected should include contextual factors such as the social determinants.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, what matters most to patients and caregivers in their healthcare experiences?
the question, “What matters to people who use and care about health services?”
how the experiences, priorities, and values of patients, caregivers, and families are used to support ongoing quality improvements in healthcare.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
improving value for patients by capturing the things matter most to them needs to be part the continuous quality improvement process that lies at the core of a learning health systems.

improving value for patients, by capturing the important things that matter most in their lives, within their life context, needs to be a core element of continuous quality improvement that underlies a learning health system.
improving value for patients, by capturing the important things that matter most in the context of the patient’s life and health, needs to be a key part of the continuous learning health cycle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are proposing a framework for a person centred LHS.
a PC LHS is one in which patients and their caregivers are at the centre of all aspects of the system and are engaged in all aspects of the care they receive.
the PC LHS is a health system that is continually learning and improving from the perspectives of patients, caregivers and communities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PC LHS is not only an ideal, but it is also an achievable vision for health system improvement.
a PC LHS is not a static concept.
a person centred approach must be central to the learning health system concept, if it is to truly be a person centred healthcare system.
